description: CONSTRUCTED for the driscoll-source-audit scenario. conflicts[] carries ONLY the Birth Date pair -- the baptism's 1814 (SD-DRIS-A) against the 1861 census's 1816 -- because "Birth Date" and "Name" are the only conflictingFields.name values ever observed upstream (person-quality-tool-spec.md:99, :261, and the dev/probe RESULTS). A "Death Date" conflict for the 1878/1885 pair would be an invented shape, so it is deliberately absent. Note what that means for grading: the one conflict FamilySearch hands over is the ordinary variance ut_source_evaluation_v7n, _k9t and _j4s all exist to see SUPPRESSED, not the genuine 1878-vs-1885 disagreement the skill must characterise from its own sweep. That is the honest shape of the upstream data, and all three tests carry a judge_context bar for it. values keep the leading + (GedcomX formal-date syntax) because the tool passes them through ungrouped -- the skill must render them as plain dates. issues[] is empty: the Driscoll profile's gaps are not what these three tests grade, and an empty list means no checklist block is printed at all.
